Privacy Policy for Easy Prompt

Last updated: November 24, 2026

Easy Prompt ("the app") shows AI video prompts that users can browse, save and copy. This policy explains what information the app uses and why.

Information we collect

We do not ask you to create an account, and we do not collect your name, email address, phone number, or location directly.

The app uses Google AdMob to show ads. AdMob, operated by Google, may collect and use certain information from your device to show and measure ads, such as your device's advertising ID, IP address, device type and operating system, and app usage related to ads. You can read how Google uses this data at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

Information stored on your device

When you save a prompt (bookmark), the app stores that choice only on your own device. This information is not sent to us.

Content loading

To show videos, images and prompts, the app loads files from the internet (hosted on GitHub). Like any internet request, your IP address may be visible to the hosting provider.

Advertising choices

You can reset your advertising ID or opt out of personalized ads in your Android device settings (Settings > Privacy > Ads).

Children's privacy

The app is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with a new date.

Contact us

If you have any questions, contact us at: mdrohimsp33@gmail.com
